title: 103 dangling implemented_in references in docs/requirements.yaml; reqctl validate never checks them
symptom: 103 implemented_in entries across docs/requirements.yaml point at files that do not exist. reqctl.py validate does not check implemented_in paths, so this accumulated undetected.
root_cause: Three distinct causes: (1) stale GBL-0xx migration filenames after the mass renumbering in db362fd/PR #405 (same class as #337/ISS-0088 and #458/ISS-0146, both of which fixed only one consumer); (2) run-IDs such as WF02-env-batch1-20260610 written into implemented_in where a file path belongs; (3) a bare str passed where list[str] was expected, splitting 'feature/WF02-iss204-206-20260611' into one-character entries for ISS-204 and ISS-206.
acceptance_criteria: reqctl.py validate checks that every implemented_in entry resolves to an existing path (MAJOR; BLOCKER for RELEASED requirements)
ISS-204/ISS-206 character-split entries repaired and the writer that produced them fixed
python tools/reqctl.py validate exits 0 on the new check
notes: Deferred out of run WF03-gh439-testwiring-20260806: it is a registry-wide data-quality sweep plus a new validator check, unrelated to that run's test-wiring scope. ENV-01's instance of cause (1) was fixed in that run because it was encountered directly.

Correction to the filed report: the '103 dangling references' figure does not reproduce. Measured 41 on the commit where the fix began and 44 before PR #490; no point in git history shows 103. The three root causes described in the issue are all real and were confirmed independently. Additionally, the paths the issue described as 'genuinely deleted/moved source files' were verified to have ZERO commits in git history -- they never existed and were fabricated at write time, so they were dropped or repointed rather than traced to successors. The one genuine move was web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx (6 commits, removed in 8e7ea86).
resolution: Fixed all three root causes. (1) reqctl.py cmd_set_status now routes implemented_in through coerce_path_list(), so a bare str can never be stored where a list belongs -- this was the writer bug behind ISS-204/ISS-206. (2) reqctl validate gained an implemented_in check: every entry must resolve on disk and must not be a run/branch identifier; reported BLOCKER for RELEASED requirements, MAJOR otherwise. (3) All 41 dangling references repaired: 17 renamed migrations repointed (GBL-105->133, GBL-081->120, GBL-082->121), 8 fabricated source paths repointed to the real implementing files, 10 run-IDs moved out of implemented_in into note, 7 frontend paths that never existed in git history dropped, 1 ' (inferred)' suffix removed. reqctl validate now reports 0 implemented_in findings and 0 BLOCKERs.
prevention: reqctl validate now fails on any dangling implemented_in path, so this class cannot silently reaccumulate. A new `reqctl selftest` subcommand covers the coercion and run-ID-detection logic; it was mutation-checked (reintroducing the writer bug makes it exit 1).
